'''2003 Maryland State Championship Scott Lingrell DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Scott Lingrell]] at [[2003 Maryland State Championship]], finishing 2nd; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell (2003-05-03).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28699 Lingrell's CCT - MD States 2nd Place]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20070211003049/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=28699&PHPSESSID=84d2b1152e98cb77a826b3278db9feed Internet Archive]</ref>

== Original post ==

'''Lingrell's CCT - MD States 2nd Place'''
* '''Author:''' Scott "CRingwell" Lingrell
* '''Published:''' May 3, 2003
* '''Rating:''' 4.84
* '''Description:''' A deck that uses what I call 'Praskac's Tech' - Labria (V)- who allows you to track for Set For Stun and Unsalvagable

=== Strategy ===

So basically this deck did really well for me in the MD states, only losing in a timed loss to LS Senate and of course a beating in the Final Confrontation to Kevin.  Other than that, this deck really did what I wanted it to - take out Han and Lando from the opponents deck (granted I found out in game 1 of the FC some info on the replacement I didnt know, no big deal but this will change my deck a bit.)

The deck also was created to stop the R3 Falcon to be played, which is a main focus of LS space packages.

The deck has since been modified but those changes will not be seen because this deck will be modified and played in NJ states (Which I plan on winning.)

The basic idea of this deck was to start the game with Han frozen.  I would then grab Lando (not play him though) and then go get the Sail Barge with Power of the Hutt, the AC, and the Flagship bride if I had Accelerate in my opening hand.

The deck is very quick because I have huge activation.

On turn two, I pull Labria, Undercover and then from turn 3 on, I have his tracking ability to start by pulling Informant (V) and also allowing me extra activation if I need it.  I will then try and get Han to the AC via 4Lom or IG since no one plays r2 and 3po anymore, I do not fear them.

I then just go and hit and run with the EPPS while fortifying sites with the aliens I can pull using Power of the hutt and the random.characters I play.  I use Zuckuss in space along with SFS/unsalvageable to take out ships along the way, keeping my drains alive.

You need to play smart because with a bad play, a beatdown can occur quickly (esp. against WYS).

After you flip, you drop a few characters to the AC and then start your silly 1 force retrieval on your turn.  If also allows you aliens and starships to be less than
